instruction: Choose one suitable analysis backend from ANSYS and Abaqus and use a command-line or scripting workflow. At the start of the task, the available command-line entry points are ANSYS MAPDL at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`, Abaqus at `C:\SIMULIA\Commands\abaqus.bat`, and AutoCAD at `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`. AutoCAD is not a solver for this task. Build and solve a 2D axisymmetric structural model of a thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure. Coordinate system and geometry: use the global Cartesian coordinate system for the axisymmetric cross-section, with X as radial and Y as axial. The cylinder has inner diameter 50 mm and outer diameter 100 mm, so build one native rectangular area or shell-face spanning 25 <= X <= 50 mm and 0 <= Y <= 10 mm. Do not model or constrain X = 0 because the symmetry axis lies outside this annular cross-section. Material: one homogeneous, isotropic, linear-elastic steel material with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, assigned to the complete cross-section. Element and mesh: use an axisymmetric quadrilateral formulation. Abaqus may use CAX4, CAX4R, CAX4H, CAX4RH, CAX8, CAX8R, CAX8H, or CAX8RH. ANSYS may use PLANE182 or PLANE183 with KEYOPT(3) = 1. Create a mapped 5 mm by 5 mm quadrilateral grid with five radial divisions and two axial divisions, for ten connected cells covering the rectangle. Boundary conditions and load: apply a uniform 10 MPa internal pressure to the complete X = 25 mm inner wall with no overlapping load regions; keep the X = 50 mm outer wall free. Constrain only axial displacement UY = 0 on the complete Y = 0 and Y = 10 mm faces. The effective boundary-condition coverage may use one or more native objects, but it must cover exactly those two axial faces in UY only. Do not constrain radial UX anywhere and do not add other loads, constraints, initial states, interactions, nonlinear material behavior, geometry, analysis steps, or unrelated model data. Run one linear static structural step. Deliverables: place exactly one selected-backend native model/result pair on the Desktop: one Abaqus CAE and its ODB, or one ANSYS DB and its RST. The model and result must describe the same solved mesh; do not submit another backend or extra native model/result files. Write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/metrics.json` containing exactly two finite numeric fields. `radial_displacement` is the maximum outward radial U1/UX over all nodes in the final static result, in mm. `max_stress` is the selected backend's final maximum von Mises/equivalent stress in MPa: for Abaqus, maximum S.mises over all integration-point values; for ANSYS, maximum nodal-averaged S,EQV over all model nodes. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
